content.short: XT.com is a global exchange known for a long list of altcoins, with spot, margin, futures, copy trading and a launchpad.
content.description: XT lists many smaller tokens alongside the majors. Markets include spot and margin trading, futures settled in USDT or in coins, leveraged ETF tokens and a copy trading feature. Idle balances can go into earn and lending products. The company also runs XT Smart Chain, an EVM-compatible network, and a launchpad that brings new projects to its users. It also offers TradFi markets, trading bots, P2P trading, an RWA zone and proof of reserves.
content.meta: Altcoin-heavy exchange with futures, copy trading, earn products and its own launchpad. Explore XT on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
